title: Maximum alert for landslides in Yakushima after torrential rains from typhoon
summary: Authorities issued a special level 5 alert on Yakushima island due to extreme risk of landslides from intense rainfall.

title: Father of girl who died on school bus expresses regret after four years
summary: The father of the girl who died abandoned in a nursery bus in Shizuoka appeared before the press lamenting not being able to save her.

title: UN adopts resolution to abandon Mercator projection in official maps
summary: The General Assembly urges use of projections that accurately represent Africa's size, correcting the traditional map's distortion.

title: Strong US job creation fuels rate hike bets and sinks stocks
summary: The US economy generated 162,000 jobs in August, exceeding forecasts, which lifted bond yields and triggered declines on Wall Street.

title: Two men rescued from tunnel after avalanche in Nepal after days trapped
summary: Two survivors were found alive in a tunnel buried by a landslide in Nepal, as search operations continue for more victims.

title: 18-year-old arrested for death of his two-month-old baby in Hiroshima
summary: Police arrested the father of the infant, who allegedly placed a plastic bag over the baby's head, though he denies the charges.

title: Data falsification scandal at Nidec: 844 cases and management pressure
summary: An external investigation revealed hundreds of irregularities in Nidec's quality controls, pointing to pressure from the founder and executives as the root cause.

title: Two new fossil species discovered in Japan: an 'armored dragon' and an ice cream-like form
summary: Researchers identified a new genus of armored dinosaur in Hokkaido and a strange Cretaceous creature in a quarry, both previously unknown.

title: Minister Redzawa meets with US to coordinate semiconductor and AI investments
summary: Japan's Economy Minister confirmed the application of exceptional tariff measures and discussed advanced technology cooperation with his US counterpart.

title: Giants pitcher Takehara shines in return to Hiroshima with 10 strikeouts
summary: Kazuyuki Takehara, a Hiroshima native, delivered a dominant six-inning scoreless performance in his first home game since 2021.

title: Constitutional Democratic Party splits into two distinct parliamentary groups
summary: The centrist party officially divides into 'division' and 'faction,' which will affect the distribution of public party funds.
